scope: reasonable survey of available sources; not a claim to have exhausted every dataset on the internet

sources.name: OpenFootball football.json
sources.reason: Audited pinned snapshot; restrict to recent five years and regular rounds.

sources.name: OpenLigaDB
sources.reason: Public historical API, content checksums and frozen snapshot; keep attribution/share-alike for adapted database.

sources.name: Fjelstul English Football Database
sources.reason: Downloaded matches/teams/seasons; score agreement only because match CSV has no match dates. Kept separate from training union.

sources.name: Football-Data.co.uk
sources.reason: Source explicitly states private individuals only and not commercial or data-training products using automated bots/scrapers/AI. No CSV downloaded.

sources.name: OpenFootball europe and england text repositories
sources.reason: Inspected pinned text and licenses. Same source family as football.json; not counted as additional independent evidence.

sources.name: footballcsv/england
sources.reason: Latest available season directory is 2020-21; outside this five-year match-date window.

sources.name: engsoccerdata
sources.reason: README limits to non-commercial use; do not merge source labels until upstream rights and scope are resolved.

sources.name: Hudl / StatsBomb Open Data
sources.reason: Selected event-data competitions, not a complete recent archive for all requested leagues. Data agreement is separate; event features not treated as pre-match inputs.

sources.name: FiveThirtyEight soccer SPI
sources.reason: Official repository currently provides links to external data files rather than an immutable CSV in that directory; not used as training evidence.

sources.name: Understat / FBref
sources.reason: Did not scrape pages or adopt third-party scrapers as permission to train/re-publish.

sources.name: Kaggle / Club Football Match Data mirrors
sources.reason: Reported Football-Data.co.uk derivation; a mirror license is not used to bypass the upstream restriction.
